'''Eppo Egbert Willem Bruins''' (born 19 September 1969) is a Dutch politician and physicist. He served as [[List of ministers of education of the Netherlands|Minister of Education, Culture and Science]] in the [[Schoof cabinet]] between July 2024 and August 2025 on behalf of [[New Social Contract]] (NSC). He was a member of the [[House of Representatives (Netherlands)|House of Representatives]] for the [[Christian Union (Netherlands)|Christian Union]] (CU) from 2015 to 2021.

Prior to his service in Parliament, Bruins was director of the {{Interlanguage link|Technologiestichting STW|nl}} from 2007 until 2015. Since 2022, he has chaired the {{Interlanguage link|Advisory Council for Science, Technology and Innovation|nl|Adviesraad voor wetenschap, technologie en innovatie}} (AWTI).

==Early life and career==
Bruins was born on 19 September 1969 in [[Apeldoorn]], [[Gelderland]].<ref name=parlement>{{cite web|url=http://www.parlement.com/id/vj0dhyyrqnij/e_e_w_eppo_bruins |title=Dr. E.E.W. (Eppo) Bruins |language=nl |publisher=Parlement.com |access-date=13 December 2015}}</ref> He attended high school at the [[Voorbereidend wetenschappelijk onderwijs|preparatory scientific education]] level at the Myrtus College in his hometown between 1982 and 1987. Bruins subsequently went to [[Utrecht University]], where he graduated with a [[Master of Science]] (MSc) degree in physics in 1991. He played the piano at a [[conservatoire]], but he never earned a diploma.<ref name="nos"/>

Afterwards, he became a doctoral researcher at Utrecht University funded by {{Interlanguage link|Stichting voor Fundamenteel Onderzoek der Materie|nl}} (Foundation for Fundamental Research on Matter, FOM) for four years. In 1995, he obtained his [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD degree]] in mathematics and physics from Utrecht University with a thesis entitled ''The magnetic form factor of the neutron''.<ref name=parlement/>

Bruins later lived in the United States, where he was a [[postdoctoral researcher]] at the [[Massachusetts Institute of Technology]] (MIT) from 1995 to 1997. He then returned to the Netherlands, where he was a project coordinator at his former employer FOM between 1997 and 2004, as well as subsequently director of operations of the Leiden Institute of Physics of the [[Leiden University]] from 2004 to 2007, before his time as director of {{Interlanguage link|Technologiestichting STW|nl}} between 2007 and 2015.<ref name="parlement" /><ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.stw.nl/nl/content/stw-directeur-eppo-bruins-verder-als-kamerlid |title=STW-directeur Eppo Bruins verder als Kamerlid |work=STW |language=nl |date=10 November 2015 |access-date=13 December 2015 |archive-date=22 December 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151222133042/http://www.stw.nl/nl/content/stw-directeur-eppo-bruins-verder-als-kamerlid |url-status=dead }}</ref>

==Politics==
Bruins was a member of the [[Christian Democratic Appeal]] (CDA). He switched to the more socially conservative [[Christian Union (Netherlands)|Christian Union]] in 2011, because he felt that the latter party put more emphasis on Christianity.<ref name=nd>{{cite web|author=Gerard Beverdam |url=https://www.nd.nl/nieuws/politiek/eppo-bruins-verruilt-wetenschap-voor-politiek.994865.lynkx |title=Eppo Bruins verruilt wetenschap voor politiek |language=nl |publisher=[[Nederlands Dagblad]] |date=10 November 2015 |access-date=13 December 2015}}</ref><ref name="trouw">{{Cite news |url = https://www.trouw.nl/politiek/de-roeping-van-onderwijsminister-eppo-bruins-kiezen-tussen-pijn-en-veel-pijn~b219c6b6/ |url-access = subscription |date = 27 November 2024 |last = Van Eijsden |first = Auke |access-date = 1 December 2024 |language = nl |website = [[Trouw]] |title = De roeping van onderwijsminister Eppo Bruins: kiezen tussen pijn en veel pijn |trans-title = The calling of education minister Eppo Bruins: Choosing between pain and more pain }}</ref> Bruins served as editor-in-chief of the magazine of Christian Union's scientific institute.<ref name=nd/>

In the [[2012 Dutch general election|parliamentary election of 2012]], Bruins was placed as number six on the Christian Union list but was not elected.<ref name=nd/> On 2 December 2015, he became member of the [[House of Representatives (Netherlands)|House of Representatives]], when he replaced former party leader [[Arie Slob]] who had resigned as a parliamentarian.<ref name=nieuwlid>{{cite web|url=http://www.parlement.com/id/vjzijc1jcghd/nieuws/eppo_bruins_nieuw_tweede_kamerlid_voor |title=Eppo Bruins nieuw Tweede Kamerlid voor de ChristenUnie |language=nl |publisher=Parlement.com |date=2 December 2015 |access-date=13 December 2015}}</ref> He was his party's spokesperson for matters including education, media, and aviation.<ref name="nos"/> Bruins opposed the opening of an expanded [[Lelystad Airport]], and he advocated for the reintroduction of a [[Grant (money)|basic grant]] for students.<ref name="nrc"/> He was a strong defender of [[Constitution of the Netherlands|the Constitution]]'s [[freedom of education]].<ref name="trouw"/> In the [[2021 Dutch general election|parliamentary election of 2021]], he was placed seventh on the party list, failing to win re-election.

He became chairperson of the Advisory Council for Science, Technology and Innovation (AWTI) in 2022.<ref name="nos">{{Cite news |url = https://nos.nl/artikel/2524235-oud-kamerlid-cu-voor-nsc-op-onderwijs-deze-namen-weten-we-nu |date = 12 June 2024 |access-date = 12 June 2024 |language = nl |website = [[Nederlandse Omroep Stichting|NOS]] |title = Oud-Kamerlid CU voor NSC op Onderwijs, deze namen weten we nu |trans-title = Former CU MP for education on behalf of NSC, these are the names known }}</ref><ref name="nrc"/> In 2023, following the resignation of then party leader [[Gert-Jan Segers]] as a parliamentarian, a seat in Parliament was proposed to Bruins, who declined to return. The seat went to [[Nico Drost]] instead. Bruins headed the committee that determined [[List of Christian Union candidates in the 2023 Dutch general election|the party list of the Christian Union]] in the [[2023 Dutch general election|November 2023 general election]].<ref name="ad"/><ref>{{Cite report |url = https://dnpprepo.ub.rug.nl/88201/7/ChristenUnie%20Rapport%20selectiecommissie%20TK2023%20%287%20september%29%2049e%20Partijcongres%202023.pdf |date = September 2023 |access-date = 8 January 2025 |language = nl |title = Rapportage Selectiecommissie Kandidatenlijst Verkiezingen Tweede Kamer 2023 |trans-title = Selection committee report on the party list for the 2023 general election |via = Documentation Centre Dutch Political Parties |publisher = [[Christian Union (Netherlands)|Christian Union]] }}</ref> He was about to become a [[Academic ranks in the Netherlands|professor by special appointment]] at [[Leiden University]], when he joined the [[Schoof cabinet]].<ref name="nrc"/>

===Minister of Education, Culture and Science===
After the [[Party for Freedom|PVV]], [[VVD]], [[New Social Contract|NSC]], and [[Farmer–Citizen Movement|BBB]] formed the Schoof cabinet, Bruins was sworn in as Minister of Education, Culture and Science on 2 July 2024, succeeding [[Robbert Dijkgraaf]].<ref name="nos"/><ref>{{Cite news |url = https://nos.nl/collectie/13962/artikel/2527025-ministers-en-staatssecretarissen-kabinet-schoof-beedigd |date = 2 July 2024 |access-date = 2 July 2024 |language = nl |website = [[Nederlandse Omroep Stichting|NOS]] |title = Ministers en staatssecretarissen kabinet-Schoof beëdigd |trans-title = Ministers and state secretaries of Schoof cabinet sworn in }}</ref> Bruins serves on behalf of NSC, and he canceled his membership of the Christian Union. Party leader [[Mirjam Bikker]] (CU) disapproved of Bruins's nomination.<ref name="nos"/><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.nd.nl/nieuws/politiek/1228044/eppo-bruins-zegt-lidmaatschap-van-christenunie-op-partij-moet |title=Eppo Bruins zegt lidmaatschap van ChristenUnie op. 'Partij moet vrijuit oppositie kunnen voeren' |website=Nederlands Dagblad |date=13 June 2024 |accessdate=13 June 2024}}</ref> The Schoof cabinet's governing agreement prioritized reading, writing, and arithmetic abilities, as well as addressing the teacher shortage.<ref>{{Cite news |url = https://nos.nl/artikel/2536995-kabinet-ambitieus-over-asiel-en-bouwen-maar-stuit-bij-mest-op-grenzen |date = 13 September 2024 |access-date = 21 September 2024 |language = nl |website = [[Nederlandse Omroep Stichting|NOS]] |title = Kabinet ambitieus over asiel en bouwen, maar stuit bij mest op grenzen |trans-title = Cabinet ambitious on asylum and construction, but is constrained on manure }}</ref>

The cabinet proposed to cut the yearly education budget by €2 billion. Half of that amount was for higher education, and it would be achieved through lowering the amount of international students, increasing tuition for students exceeding the standard duration, and decreasing funding for research. The [[coalition agreement]] included a plan to terminate 1,200 recently created academic positions, but this measure was replaced in the budget proposal by the elimination of research grants.<ref>{{Cite news |url = https://www.nrc.nl/nieuws/2024/09/23/het-kabinet-bezuinigt-niet-op-universitaire-banen-maar-op-onderzoeksbeurzen-de-schade-blijft-even-groot-zeggen-universiteiten-a4866797 |url-access = subscription |date = 23 September 2024 |last = Kammer |first = Claudia |access-date = 23 September 2024 |language = nl |website = [[NRC (newspaper)|NRC]] |title = Het kabinet bezuinigt niet op universitaire banen maar op onderzoeksbeurzen. De schade blijft even groot, zeggen universiteiten |trans-title = The cabinet will not cut jobs at universities but will cut funding for research grants. The damage will be as significant, according to universities }}</ref> During debates on the [[2025 Netherlands budget|2025 budget]], the cuts were criticized by opposition parties, whose support was required to approve the budget in the [[Senate (Netherlands)|Senate]]. Bruins responded that he would not reverse any cuts, and he called them necessary in light of the cabinet's financial priorities. Without his involvement, the four coalition parties negotiated with several centrist and conservative opposition parties, calling themselves the "unholy alliance". In December 2024, an agreement was struck to reduce the €2 billion cut by €750 million.<ref>{{Cite news |url = https://www.nrc.nl/nieuws/2024/11/26/coalitie-is-niet-bang-om-met-onderwijsbezuinigingen-op-een-muur-af-te-rijden-a4874581 |url-access = subscription |date = 26 November 2024 |last = Kammer |first = Claudia |access-date = 1 December 2024 |language = nl |website = [[NRC (newspaper)|NRC]] |title = Coalitie is niet bang om met onderwijsbezuinigingen op een muur af te rijden |trans-title = Coalition is not afraid to drive into a wall with education cuts }}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |url = https://www.volkskrant.nl/politiek/coalitie-en-vier-oppositiepartijen-eens-over-afgezwakte-bezuinigingen-op-onderwijsbegroting~b8d6ee63/ |url-access = subscription |date = 11 December 2024 |last = Meijer |first = Remco |access-date = 14 December 2024 |language = nl |website = [[de Volkskrant]] |title = Coalitie en vier oppositiepartijen eens over afgezwakte bezuinigingen op onderwijsbegroting |trans-title = Coalition and four opposition parties in agreement on watered-down cuts in education budget }}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |url = https://www.nrc.nl/nieuws/2024/12/12/monsterverbond-staat-niet-te-juichen-bij-eigen-akkoord-ovre-onderwijsbegroting-a4876539 |url-access = subscription |date = 12 December 2024 |last1 = Kammer |first1 = Claudia |last2 = De Haan |first2 = Marko |access-date = 14 December 2024 |language = nl |website = [[NRC (newspaper)|NRC]] |title = 'Monsterverbond' staat niet te juichen bij eigen akkoord over onderwijsbegroting |trans-title = 'Unholy alliance' is not cheerful about its own agreement on the educaetion budget }}</ref>

Bruins continued a bill by Dijkgraaf aimed at reducing the number of international students. The bill would limit the proportion of English-taught content to one third within each [[bachelor's degree]] program, with the remainder to be taught in Dutch. Exceptions would be made for regional circumstances, labor market needs, international uniqueness, and international positioning. Bruins intended to define the latter two grounds more narrowly than his predecessor.<ref>{{Cite news |url = https://www.nrc.nl/nieuws/2024/10/15/onderwijsminister-bruins-strenger-op-engels-in-het-hoger-onderwijs-nederlands-moet-weer-de-norm-worden-a4869444 |url-access = subscription |date = 15 October 2024 |last = Retera |first = Denise |access-date = 15 October 2024 |language = nl |website = [[NRC (newspaper)|NRC]] |title = Onderwijsminister Bruins strenger op Engels in het hoger onderwijs: 'Nederlands moet weer de norm worden' |trans-title = Education minister Bruins stricter towards English in higher education: 'Dutch should be the norm again' }}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |url = https://fd.nl/politiek/1534078/kabinet-scherpt-regels-rond-internationalisering-hoger-onderwijs-verder-aan |url-access = subscription |date = 15 October 2024 |last = Timp |first = Evi |access-date = 15 October 2024 |language = nl |website = [[Het Financieele Dagblad]] |title = Kabinet scherpt regels rond internationalisering hoger onderwijs verder aan |trans-title = Cabinet further sharpens rules concerning internationalization of higher education }}</ref>

On 3 June 2025, Schoof's cabinet collapsed after the [[Party for Freedom]] pulled out of the coalition. Schoof remained as a caretaker until snap elections are held.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Dutch PM steps down after Geert Wilders quits coalition |url=https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2025/jun/03/europe-live-dutch-netherlands-far-right-leader-geert-wilders-quits-ukraine-russia-poland |date=2025-06-03 |website=[[The Guardian]]}}</ref>

==Personal life==
He is married to Marlies, and they have two sons.<ref name="ad">{{Cite news |url = https://www.ad.nl/politiek/zelfs-na-zijn-gedwongen-vertrek-bleef-bruins-het-kamergebouw-bezoeken-niet-alleen-voor-zichzelf~a201354d/ |url-access = subscription |date = 8 January 2025 |last1 = Keultjes |first1 = Hanneke |last2 = Peer |first2 = Wouter |access-date = 8 January 2025 |language = nl |website = [[Algemeen Dagblad]] |title = Zelfs na zijn gedwongen vertrek bleef Bruins het Kamergebouw bezoeken, niet alleen voor zichzelf |trans-title = Even after his forced departure Bruins kept visiting the parliament building, no only for himself }}</ref> As of 2024, he lived in [[Ermelo, Netherlands|Ermelo]].<ref name="nrc"/>

Bruins had an irreligious upbringing. He played piano in the [[backup band]] of a Christian choir, and he has told that he converted to Christianity at the age of 18 after he was asked to sing "And in That Day" by [[Adrian Snell]]. Bruins initially was a member of the [[Reformed Association in the Protestant Church in the Netherlands]] before becoming a [[Baptists|Baptist]].<ref name=parlement/><ref name=nd/><ref name="nrc"/> Bruins became the second Baptist member of the House of Representatives after {{ill|Janmarc Lenards|nl}}.<ref name=nieuwlid/> An [[evangelism|evangelist]], he is involved in the Christian Hadderech movement, which focuses on missionary work among Jews.<ref>{{Cite news |url = https://www.nrc.nl/nieuws/2024/06/13/politieke-ervaring-genoeg-in-het-kabinet-schoof-maar-soms-is-de-benoeming-wel-heel-verrassend-a4856356 |url-access = subscription |date = 13 June 2024 |access-date = 18 June 2024 |language = nl |website = [[NRC (newspaper)|NRC]] |title = Van diplomaat tot Boer zoekt Vrouw-kandidaat: dit zijn de beoogde ministers van het kabinet-Schoof |trans-title = From diplomat to ''Farmer Wants Wife'' contender: These are the ministers-designate of the Schoof cabinet |first1 = Steven |last1 = Derix |first2 = Pim |last2 = Van den Dool |first3 = Derk |last3 = Stokmans |first4 = Oscar |last4 = Vermeer |first5 = Sjoerd |last5 = Klumpenaar |first6 = Eppo |last6 = König |first7 = Christiaan |last7 = Pelgrim |first8 = Boris |last8 = Bouwman }}</ref> Bruins regularly visited the House of Representatives after his departure as an informal religious counselor along with a member of [[Justice House of Prayer]], praying for members of parliament, and he [[blessing|blessed]] the temporary house of parliament, when the [[Binnenhof]] was closed due to [[2021–present Binnenhof renovation|a renovation]].<ref name="nrc">{{Cite news |url = https://www.nrc.nl/nieuws/2024/11/29/onderwijsminister-eppo-bruins-nsc-slalomt-om-zijn-eigen-normen-en-waarden-a4874932 |url-access = subscription |date = 29 November 2024 |last1 = Retera |first1 = Denise |last2 = Kammer |first2 = Claudia |access-date = 1 December 2024 |language = nl |website = [[NRC (newspaper)|NRC]] |title = Onderwijsminister Eppo Bruins (NSC) slalomt om zijn eigen normen en waarden |trans-title = Education minister Eppo Bruins (NSC) slaloms around his own norms and values }}</ref>
